Meet Teigen

Born and raised in Wyoming. I'm a REALTOR® (License #16621) with Marchant Wyo Realty, part of Keller Williams Realty Black Hills. I graduated from Eastern Wyoming College and Chadron State College with a degree in Business Administration.

I coach high school wrestling, I serve on the board of the Weston County Fairgrounds, and I founded the Marchant Wyo Trade Excellence Scholarship.

KW Black Hills recognition: 4x Top Sales, 3x Top Listings, 3x Rock Star Award, 2023 Silver Award, two-time BOLD graduate, two-time Back At You Social Media Award.
